description: A React component named SessionsByOrganization that renders a responsive bar chart showing session counts grouped by organization name. The component uses the recharts library for visualization and includes features such as tooltips, loading/error states, and label truncation.

methods.name: truncateLabel
methods.description: A helper function to truncate long labels to a maximum length, adding an ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React component that renders a custom tooltip for the bar chart, displaying the organization name and session count.
